Summary: Canonical ownership relationships print as 'A -> B' with no holder/issuer direction in the left brief (NVIDIA as issuer and as holder look identical)
Description: 1) Original intent: the guest can tell who holds whom (rubric item 3: who discloses beneficial ownership of the subject, and in the other direction what the subject holds). 2) Acceptance criteria: each canonical HAS_BENEFICIAL_OWNERSHIP_DISCLOSURE line in the left brief states the direction in words, the same sentence the MAP uses ('X has disclosed beneficial ownership in Y'), or groups holders of the subject apart from the subject's own holdings; the subject's holdings (NVIDIA holds Nebius, CoreWeave) are distinguishable from holders of the subject (Vanguard holds NVIDIA); wording only, no change to admission or data. 3) Current implementation state: structuralbrief.jsx lists each admitted relationship as 'part[0] -> part[1] - TYPE'; the MAP panel renders the direction sentence (structure-field.html relationshipSentence). NVIDIA 2026-10-09 run: 'Nebius -> NVIDIA' and 'NVIDIA -> Vanguard' read the same although the first means NVIDIA is the holder. 4) Dependencies: rubric item 3; relationshipSentence in structure-field.html is the reference wording. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none. 6) Maps to current product model: yes. Presentation only (Lightweight).
